summary: Claim o-598d48308276689a remains unresolved: the old harness cannot emit caller-supplied gzip header fields if gzip support is enabled, but the supplied evidence does not establish the effective GZIP build setting.
missing_information: The effective GZIP definition when deflate.c is compiled by the supplied configure and make recipe.

claims.necessity_reason: Both versions can install and emit caller-supplied gzip header fields when GZIP is enabled. The complete old harness uses deflateInit and never calls deflateSetHeader. The opening guard for GZIP and its effective build setting are missing, so applicability under the fixed recipe is unresolved.

before.requirement: For a supported gzip-wrapped deflate stream, make caller-supplied header fields installed through deflateSetHeader reachable and emit them.
before.reason: Window bits can select gzip wrapping only under GZIP. If enabled, the fixed deflateInit call selects the default wrapper and the harness has no header-installation route.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: GZIP guards selection of the gzip wrapper through windowBits.
deflateInit delegates to deflateInit2_ with the default window bits.

after.requirement: For a supported gzip-wrapped deflate stream, make caller-supplied header fields installed through deflateSetHeader reachable and emit them.
after.reason: The header installation and emission contracts remain available under GZIP. The same fixed harness still uses the default initializer and supplies no header; effective GZIP support remains unresolved.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: GZIP guards selection of the gzip wrapper through windowBits.
deflateInit still delegates to deflateInit2_ with the default window bits.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete entry calls only the fixed flush and sync helpers for accepted input.
The recipe delegates compilation settings to configure and make.

claims.comparison_reason: Conditional on GZIP being enabled, the same default-wrapper initialization and absence of deflateSetHeader block this identical behavior before and after. The effective build setting prevents a definite applicability or maintenance finding.
missing_information: The guard defining GZIP in deflate.h and the effective compile definitions for deflate.c under the supplied configure and make defaults.
